{{Quote|That's why I started the journal. I need a place to ponder possibilities and courses of actions. As Queen, I have allies and advisors and counselors. But when it comes to decisions, I am alone.|Padmé Amidala|<ref name="E1J:QA">''[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala]]''</ref>}}
[[File:QueenAmidala1.jpg|thumb|150px|Queen Padmé Amidala, author of the journal]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] started a '''journal''' in order to put her thoughts into writing and help her solve the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|crisis]] raging on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. That journal covered the events of the conflict from the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to the Nabooian victory both [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|on ground]] and [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|in space]]. It ended with a description of the [[Freedom of Naboo/Legends|celebrations]] that followed the victory, with Amidala musing on fate and destiny. The journal also documented Amidala's first meeting with her friend [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="E1J:QA" /> her future [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] and murderer.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[1999]] novel [[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala|''Star Wars Episode I Journal: Queen Amidala'']] was written by [[Jude Watson]] from an in-universe perspective, from the point of view of Amidala.
